newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Precious metals mixed in tentative Europe trade.
newsitem.headline: Precious metals mixed in tentative Europe trade.

text.p: Precious metals open mixed in cautious European trade on Friday, with some traders expecting a consolidation in platinum and palladium after their sharp rises this week.
Platinum opened unchanged from the London close at $409.00/$413.00. Palladium eased 50 cents to $188.00/$192.00.
"At the moment there seems to be some consolidation," one dealer at a major Swiss bank said, adding price movements would continue to be volatile.
The market remained on edge, waiting for news on deliveries from Russia, he added.

Gold firmed to $345.25/$345.75 from $343.80/$344.30, but was seen moving in narrow ranges. The public row between the German government and the Bundesbank over Bonn's plan to revalue German gold reserves was not having much impact.
Traders said producers were not a big factor.
Silver firmed to $4.83/$4.85 from $4.77/$4.79, but was seen moving in a range of around two or three cents an ounce for the time being.
